# Hei Digi

> Hei Digi is a premier digital marketing agency located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India. Founded and led by Coach Sri, Hei Digi specializes in Local SEO, Google Business Profile management, Social Media Marketing (Instagram & Facebook), Meta Ads, Creative Design, Content Strategy, Performance Marketing, and Founder Personal Branding for businesses across Tirupati, Chittoor, Renigunta, and Andhra Pradesh.

## Overview & Background

- [About Hei Digi](https://heidigi.com/about/): Agency philosophy, go-to-market strategy, founder Coach Sri, and marketing built around customer problems rather than channel tactics.
- [Contact Hei Digi](https://heidigi.com/contact/): Verified office address (18-1-45/4, HeiDigi, KT Rd, near More Super Market, Srinivasa Nagar, Shanthi Nagar, Khadi Colony, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh 517507), phone (+91 97055 70007), email (info.heidigi@gmail.com), WhatsApp and Google Maps directions.

- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://heidigi.com/services/seo/): Technical, on-page and local SEO built around how customers search.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://heidigi.com/services/social-media-marketing/): A consistent Instagram and Facebook presence for local brands.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://heidigi.com/services/google-business-profile-management/): Accurate, active profiles that help local customers find you.
- [Meta Ads](https://heidigi.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram campaigns for leads and WhatsApp enquiries.
- [Creative Design](https://heidigi.com/services/creative-design/): Posts, posters, carousels and banners in one consistent look.

- [Personal Branding](https://heidigi.com/services/personal-branding/): Content and positioning for doctors, founders and professionals.
- [Content Strategy](https://heidigi.com/services/content-strategy/): Content pillars, calendars and campaign ideas tied to your goals.

## Industries Served

- [Healthcare Marketing](https://heidigi.com/industries/healthcare/): Patients and families often look for a clinic's speciality, location, hours and appointment route before they call. Healthcare marketing needs clear information and careful approvals, not exaggerated promises.
- [Education Marketing](https://heidigi.com/industries/education/): Families compare schools by location, communication, facilities, programmes and how clearly a school answers questions. Useful education marketing gives parents accurate information and a straightforward path to enquire.
- [Steel & Construction Marketing](https://heidigi.com/industries/steel-construction/): Buyers often need to confirm product range, stock, location, delivery area and how to reach the sales team. Marketing should make those answers easy to find before a call.
- [Hospitality Marketing](https://heidigi.com/industries/hospitality/): Guests need clear location, room or service information, current photos and a simple booking route. Hospitality content should set accurate expectations and make the next step easy.
- [Professional Services Marketing](https://heidigi.com/industries/professional-services/): A professional's website and profile should quickly explain who they help, what they do and how someone can start a conversation. Trust comes from useful information and consistent communication rather than inflated claims.

## Service Locations

- [Tirupati](https://heidigi.com/locations/tirupati/): Tirupati businesses serve residents, pilgrims, students, patients and nearby towns. The right marketing mix depends on who you need to reach and what they need to know before contacting you.
- [Chittoor](https://heidigi.com/locations/chittoor/): Businesses in Chittoor need marketing that reflects their real service area, not a page that swaps one town name for another. We plan the message around the products, services and customers the business actually serves.
- [Renigunta](https://heidigi.com/locations/renigunta/): Renigunta businesses may serve local residents, travellers or customers moving between nearby towns. Useful marketing starts by stating what the business offers, where it operates and how customers can reach the team.

- [Marketing Guides Hub](https://heidigi.com/blog/): Plain-language guides on local SEO, Google Business Profile, Meta Ads, and reporting.
- [A Practical Local SEO Checklist for Tirupati Businesses](https://heidigi.com/blog/local-seo-tirupati-business/): A practical local SEO checklist for Tirupati businesses: website pages, Google Business Profile accuracy, customer questions and monthly measurement.
- [Google Business Profile Tips for Hospitals and Clinics](https://heidigi.com/blog/google-business-profile-hospitals/): How hospitals and clinics can keep Google Business Profile details accurate, publish useful updates and measure patient-facing actions responsibly.
- [Planning Meta Ads for School Admissions](https://heidigi.com/blog/meta-ads-schools/): A practical plan for school admission campaigns on Meta: parent-focused messaging, creative approvals, geographic settings, enquiry handling and reporting.
- [How Much Does Digital Marketing Cost in Tirupati?](https://heidigi.com/blog/digital-marketing-cost-tirupati/): Understand digital marketing costs in Tirupati, what affects service fees, how ad spend is separated and what to ask before approving a proposal.
- [A Monthly Social Media Calendar for Local Businesses](https://heidigi.com/blog/social-media-calendar-local-business/): Build a realistic monthly social media calendar around customer questions, useful proof, service explainers, local updates and measurable calls to action.
- [Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Which Should a Local Business Use?](https://heidigi.com/blog/google-ads-vs-meta-ads/): Compare Google Ads and Meta Ads by customer intent, creative needs, budget, lead handling and how local businesses should measure results.
- [Personal Branding for Doctors: A Responsible Content Plan](https://heidigi.com/blog/personal-branding-doctors/): A responsible personal-branding plan for doctors with educational content pillars, approval steps, patient privacy and simple monthly measurement.
- [What a Useful Monthly Digital Marketing Report Should Include](https://heidigi.com/blog/monthly-marketing-report/): A useful monthly marketing report separates work completed, search visibility, profile activity, campaign costs and confirmed business enquiries.
- [SEO Checklist for Schools and Education Centres](https://heidigi.com/blog/seo-checklist-schools/): A practical SEO checklist for schools and education centres covering admissions pages, location details, parent questions and student privacy.
- [Short Video Ideas for Steel and Construction Businesses](https://heidigi.com/blog/video-content-construction-business/): Practical short-video ideas for steel, ready-mix concrete and construction businesses, with safety, product accuracy and lead tracking in mind.
- [What to Post on a Google Business Profile Each Month](https://heidigi.com/blog/google-business-profile-posts/): Plan useful Google Business Profile posts with confirmed updates, clear calls to action and a monthly review of customer-facing information.
